title: AlignmentAnalyzer and FractionalDelay — cross-correlation, Lagrange interpolation
description:
Implement DI key alignment DSP: AlignmentAnalyzer (onset envelopes + normalized cross-correlation + calibration workflow) and FractionalDelay (preallocated circular buffer with third-order Lagrange interpolation for sub-sample key delay).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md section 13 (onset cross-correlation, delay direction, implementation range, calibration workflow, latency reporting intent)
- Source/PluginProcessor.* / bus layout notes for key vs main path roles (read only)
- Existing Source/DSP/ delay or buffer patterns if any; prepare/reset/process style

Implement FractionalDelay.h/.cpp:
- Preallocated mono circular buffer; prepare(sampleRate, maxDelayMs) allocates max capacity once (or constructor fixed max covering ±100 ms at highest supported SR).
- setDelayMs(delayMs) / setDelaySamples(fractionalSamples) with clamp to configured range (default ±25 ms operational, extended ±100 ms capacity).
- process sample- or block-wise with third-order Lagrange interpolation (4-point) for sub-sample precision. Integer-only path may short-circuit when fractional part ~0.
- reset() clears buffer to zeros. No allocations in process(). Manual trim resolution supports 0.01 ms effective set precision.

Implement AlignmentAnalyzer.h/.cpp per §13.2–13.5:
- Onset envelope from conditioned energy on key and audio:
  p[n] = (1-alpha_p)*x²[n] + alpha_p*p[n-1]
  E[n] = sqrt(p[n] + eps)
  O[n] = max(0, E[n] - E[n-d])
- Normalized cross-correlation R_KA[k] over a lag search window covering default ±25 ms (extended ±100 ms optional); k* = argmax_k R_KA[k]; convert k* to milliseconds and delay direction (positive ⇒ delay key path; negative ⇒ main-path lookahead needed / warn flag).
- Robust median across multiple onset-pair / block estimates with confidence and variation metrics.
- Calibration workflow API: startAlign()/cancel()/accept() collecting while user plays muted and open notes. Heavy correlation over longer windows must be designed for off-audio-thread or control-rate completion (document/push work to processOfflineAnalysis() / finishCalibrationChunk()); audio-thread path only pushes preallocated onset samples into lock-free or single-producer fixed rings — no large heap correlation on the realtime path (risk_notes: cross-correlation off audio thread).
- Expose recommended key delay ms, confidence, variation, needsMainLookahead flag.

Do NOT edit PluginProcessor or CMakeLists.txt (e.4). Do NOT write tests (e.5). Do NOT implement CadenceTracker or NoiseFloorEstimator.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: FractionalDelay uses a preallocated circular buffer and third-order Lagrange interpolation for fractional delays
FractionalDelay supports operational delay range covering at least ±25 ms with capacity up to ±100 ms extended
AlignmentAnalyzer builds onset envelopes O[n] = max(0, E[n]-E[n-d]) from conditioned energy envelopes
AlignmentAnalyzer computes normalized cross-correlation R_KA[k], selects k* = argmax, and reports delay ms, confidence, and direction/lookahead-needed
Calibration workflow supports start/collect/accept (or equivalent) without applying delay until accepted
No heap allocation in FractionalDelay process path; AlignmentAnalyzer heavy correlation is not required to run fully on the audio thread
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: use plain C++20 + JUCE types already in the project
third-order (4-point) Lagrange interpolation in FractionalDelay v1.0
fixed-capacity onset rings + off-thread/control-rate correlation worker API on AlignmentAnalyzer
separate FractionalDelay instance ownership for key path delay
forbidden: change reported host latency semantics inside PluginProcessor (e.4 owns reporting hooks)
